title: Are "Solved Issues" in SWE-bench Really Solved Correctly? An Empirical Study
summary: The original PatchDiff pipeline compares a plausible patch against the developer/oracle patch by generating differential tests, filtering flaky tests, and checking whether the generated tests expose behavioral differences between the two patches.

This reproduction replaces PatchDiff's full differential-testing workflow with a simplified single-LLM prompt that directly generates one differentiating Python test from the issue statement, plausible patch, and oracle patch.

dataset.name: SWE-bench Verified with PatchDiff tool results
